🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; mixed signals with SPY/TLT strength versus rising credit stress. SPY/TLT (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +4.62%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and HYG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) & LQD (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.59%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) & LQD (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.59%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Stocks vs bonds supportive: SPY/TLT (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +4.62%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Volatility mixed: VIX (1W: +1.81% | 1M: -3.00%) ↑ rising RECOVERY while VXX (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -3.54%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND (complacent).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength elevated: UUP proxy (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +2.06%) → flat ABOVE TREND. Yield curve flattening: Yield Curve (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -3.73%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -3.89% | 1M: -5.06%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Healthcare (XLV) RECOVERY (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -0.54%), Materials (XLB) RECOVERY (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -6.38%), Staples (XLP) RECOVERY (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -2.50%). Tech (XLK) in CORRECTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%) and Financials (XLF) BELOW TREND (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -6.26%) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -0.47%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Emerging markets lag: EEM (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -0.61%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and China (FXI) BELOW TREND (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -3.04%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling: IBIT (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +4.24%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.14%) CORRECTION; small caps weak: IWM (1W: -1.95% | 1M: -6.36%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial vs precious metals divergence: CPER (1W: -2.43% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND while Gold (GLD) (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Brent strength notable: BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.29%) with crude (BNO) ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%) and natural gas (UNG) ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: SPY/TLT ratio ABOVE TREND and commodity pockets (BNO, UNG) showing strength. Divergence: Credit (HYG/LQD ↓ falling) plus narrow sector breadth (3/11) and momentum names in CORRECTION (XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%), QQQ (1W: -0.67% | 1M: +2.24%), ARKK (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.14%), IBIT (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +4.24%)) — momentum pullback amid weak breadth.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Monitor defensive/quality sectors showing strength (XLV (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -0.54%), XLB (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -6.38%), XLP (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -2.50%)); reduce exposure to weak cyclicals/financials and beaten commodities miners (XLF (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -6.26%), XLU (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -8.43%)). Stay selective given mixed signals and low breadth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Healthcare (XLV (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -0.54%)) and Materials (XLB (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -6.38%)) for relative strength. BEARISH: Financials (XLF (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -6.26%)) and Tech momentum names (XLK (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +3.26%)) for continued churn.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent (BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%)) and Natural Gas (UNG (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +3.45%)). BEARISH: Gold (GLD (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.58%)) and Silver (SLV (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -12.46%)).

13. Key Levels?
VIX 17.46 (watch for move above 20), SPY/TLT 9.7381 (stocks vs bonds pivot), Credit spread HYG/LQD ~0.7567 (credit stress), Breadth 3/11 (narrow/weak).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth 3/11 sectors positive with mixed signals — SPY/TLT rising but credit stress (HYG/LQD) increasing. Healthcare (XLV (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -0.54%)) and energy/commodities pockets (BNO (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +16.67%)) showing relative strength. Key risk is rising credit stress and narrow breadth with momentum names in CORRECTION — monitor HYG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.39%) and XLK/QQQ/IBIT for spillover.
